description: ADR 01185: the stdio match output is `stdioMatches` on runShell, runCode, and type, with no alias for the old `stdioMatched` name. Each test captures both names through step variables and asserts in runShell through process.env: the new name is the real verdict, and the old one never resolves to a verdict. Node only, so every test runs and PASSes on every platform.

steps.description: The new name is true, and the old name has no verdict.
steps.runShell: node -e "const e = { n: process.env.ON_SHELL_NEW, o: process.env.ON_SHELL_OLD }; const ok = e.n === 'true' && e.o !== 'true' && e.o !== 'false'; if (!ok) { console.error(JSON.stringify(e)); process.exit(1) }"
